history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all. I can't make calls, send texts, or use data. Nothing loads and I can't send picture messages either.

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently active, so let's proceed with troubleshooting your phone's service.

To begin, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help determine if Airplane Mode is on, if there is no signal, or if there are any other indicators of the issue.
My status bar shows Airplane Mode is on, No Signal, Data Enabled, and the battery at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled on your phone. When Airplane Mode is on, all wireless connections—including cellular service—are disabled, which explains why you have no service.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do, check if your service returns (signal bars should appear and you should be able to make calls, send texts, and use data). Let me know if you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode or if the issue persists after turning it off.
Airplane Mode is now off, but I still have no signal—no bars, just 'No Signal' at the top. The problem is still there.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, let's check your SIM card status next, as issues with the SIM card can cause a complete loss of service.

Please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know what it says (e.g., Active, Missing, Locked). If you need instructions on how to check this, let me know your phone model or operating system (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you.
My SIM card status shows 'Active,' but I still have no service—no bars or signal.

Thank you for checking your SIM card status. Since your SIM card is active but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your phone’s network settings, specifically the Access Point Name (APN) settings, as incorrect APN settings can cause service issues.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything appears incorrect or if the APN/MMSC fields are empty. If you’re unsure how to check this, let me know your phone model or operating system, and I can provide step-by-step instructions.
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is 'fast.telecom.net', but it says the APN settings are 'Not set'. The MMSC URL is filled in as 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc.'

Thank you for checking your APN settings. Since the APN settings are showing as "Not set," this could be causing your service issue.

Please reset your APN settings to the default values on your phone. After resetting, you will need to reboot (restart) your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you have reset the APN settings and rebooted your phone, or if you need instructions on how to do this.
I followed your instructions and reset the APN settings to default, then rebooted my phone. Unfortunately, I still have no service—no bars or signal at the top.

Thank you for resetting your APN settings and rebooting your phone. Since your SIM card is active, your line is active, and you have already tried resetting the APN settings and rebooting, but you still have no service, this may indicate a more complex technical issue.

At this point, I will transfer you to a human agent who can provide further assistance and perform advanced troubleshooting.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
Okay, I'll hold for the human agent. Please let me know when someone is available.
Thank you for your patience. A human agent will assist you shortly. Please stay on the line.
